title: SMOK Acro Replacement Pods 0.8ohm Mesh
description: The specially designed refillable Smok Acro pods hold up to 2ml of e-liquid and can be refilled multiple times. They also feature a built-in coil for extra convenience. With no messy coil changes to fiddle with, you can just replace the entire pod when the coil’s life runs out. The pod’s built-in coil is long-lasting thanks to organic cotton wicks and Smok’s mesh coil build. To refill, simply remove the pod from the device and carefully open the silicon stopper, fill with e-liquid, replace the stopper and let the liquid saturate the coil for 5-10 minutes before use. The Smok Acro Kit is a super-compact and lightweight pod kit that nevertheless boasts incredible power and performance to offer a take-anywhere vape kit that delivers outstanding flavour and satisfaction. These pods are best suited to 50/50 , Nic Salts or High-PG E-Liquids.
